scores.label: A
scores.note: Strong top three (urges, presses, goads). 5 compels overstates: it means he had no choice, contradicting 'finally agrees'. 8 'insists he' gives 'insists he him to kill', ungrammatical. 9 'pushes him' repeats the original and doubles 'him'. 10 'urges him' doubles 'him'.

scores.label: B
scores.note: urges and pressures are good. 2 forces overstates certainty (he 'finally agrees'). 3 'demands him to kill' is ungrammatical. 4 inspires gives a positive sense wrong for pressure to murder. Options 7-10 are duplicates.
